page.overview:
Who is Angry Customer?

The angry customer is a man who dislikes the expensive prices and corrupt practices of the Kwik-E-Mart. He attempts to take revenge by throwing and crushing one of the business' Twinkies, which Apu Nahasapeemapetilon points out is impossible.
